name: agentic-coding-harness
description: Agent-first workflows, templates, and validation scripts for creating, reviewing, refining, and maintaining repository coding harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: Create, review, refine, and validate agent-first coding harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Agent-first workflows, templates, examples, and scripts for creating, reviewing, refining, and validating repository-specific harnesses with concise agent entry maps, repo-local knowledge systems, inspectable runtime evidence, mechanical enforcement, verification gates, feedback loops, and handoff artifacts for coding agents.
defaultPrompt: Interview me, then create a detailed agentic coding harness for this repository.
Ask me the required scope, boundary, verification, and handoff questions before drafting a coding harness.
Design an agent-first harness with a repo knowledge map, mechanical checks, and feedback loops.
Review this generated coding harness section by section.
Refine this reviewed coding harness until every section is complete.
Validate this repository's agentic coding harness.
